ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-20-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a minor.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/V.Mack, CSR: Janet Pond.
Petitioners, Ronika Lal and Hohammed Faiyaz present with minor in pro per, were sworn and examined.
The Court grants the petition for change of the MINOR'S name to : Shameel Rehan Faiyaz.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Nov-13-2003 Reset To Nov-20-03 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC for change of name for a minor.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/V.Mack, CSR: Gena Eales.
Petitioner, Ronika Lall present in pro per with the minor, Shameel Rehan Jussan, were sworn and examined.
This matter is continued to Nov. 20, 2003 at 09:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
For the minor's father to appear and sign the petiton.
